documents.name: Palace of Westminster
documents.summary: A rare, well-interpreted tour through the working Commons and Lords chambers, Westminster Hall and the institutional heart of UK Parliament.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Book a guided tour if available; choose audio for language/flexibility. Treat the separate Big Ben climb as a child/sub-experience rather than a second parent pin.

booking.note: Advance booking is strongly recommended for price and guaranteed entry.

mobility.note: Expect roughly 90 minutes of walking/standing; the standard Palace tour is materially easier than the separate 334-step Big Ben tour.

coverImage.alt: Palace of Westminster and Elizabeth Tower beside the River Thames.

documents.name: St Paul's Cathedral
documents.summary: Christopher Wren's cathedral earns a deliberate visit through the combination of monumental interior, crypt and a demanding 528-step dome ascent.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Allow around two hours and climb as high as comfort and mobility allow; the full A-tier case assumes interest in both the building and its galleries.

booking.note: Advance sightseeing tickets are available and sensible for a planned London day.

mobility.note: The cathedral floor/crypt are much easier than the 528-step Golden Gallery; heights and confined stairs matter.

coverImage.alt: Aerial view of St Paul's Cathedral and its dome in the City of London.

documents.name: Tower of London
documents.summary: A dense three-to-four-hour fortress visit whose Crown Jewels and consistently excellent Yeoman Warder interpretation justify deliberate itinerary time.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Prioritise a Yeoman Warder tour and the Crown Jewels, then use the remaining time for the White Tower and prison/fortress layers.

booking.note: Walk-up is possible, but online advance booking is advised during busy periods.

mobility.note: Several hours on cobbles, stairs and uneven surfaces are normal; some major areas are inaccessible by wheelchair.

documents.name: Westminster Abbey
documents.summary: One of London's densest interior history experiences: coronations, royal tombs, Poets' Corner and Gothic architecture held together by useful interpretation.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Pre-book and favour a quieter slot; use the included guide and allow enough time to step out of the main flow around the densest memorial areas.

booking.note: Timed advance booking is strongly recommended; popular slots can queue even when pre-booked.

mobility.note: Expect sustained standing/walking in a dense interior rather than a major climb; crowd flow can make rests/slow viewing harder.

coverImage.alt: Gothic west front and towers of Westminster Abbey.

documents.name: Thorpe Park Resort
documents.summary: Britain's most concentrated high-thrill theme-park day, led by Hyperia and The Swarm but materially exposed to queues and ride downtime.
documents.whyWorthwhile: Go when the forecast and crowd calendar are favourable and treat it as a coaster-focused day; the ceiling is high enough for a detour, but not reliable enough for A.

booking.note: Date-specific advance admission is the sensible default; peak days and optional Fastrack products require deliberate planning.

mobility.note: Expect a full day of walking/standing plus ride-specific height, restraint and medical restrictions.

coverImage.alt: Hyperia roller coaster rising above Thorpe Park.

documents.name: The Safari Lounge
documents.summary: A characterful Abbeyhill pub whose scratch-made, globally playful food and unusually broad gluten-free choices make it a strong deliberate neighborhood pick.
documents.whyWorthwhile: If you are around Abbeyhill, Meadowbank or the east end of Holyrood, choose it for a relaxed pub meal rather than interchangeable convenience; tacos and the changing scratch-made specials are the strongest recurring signal, especially for gluten-free diners.

customFacets.food.menuStatus: Changing globally inspired pub menu; most items are designed to be available gluten free, but the kitchen is not a dedicated gluten-free environment.

booking.note: Walk-ins are normal, but the official site accepts table bookings and the small kitchen/room can become busy.

mobility.note: Ordinary pub/restaurant physical demand; check current step-free details for individual accessibility needs.

legacy-availability-conditions.label: Availability conditions
legacy-availability-conditions.note: Food service ends earlier than the bar and the small scratch kitchen can slow during busy periods; verify the current day's kitchen hours.

legacy-reservation-requirement.label: Reservation requirement
legacy-reservation-requirement.note: Walk-ins are normal; reserve for a planned meal, larger group or busy event night.
